scenarios.invariant: Precipitation source-origin claims require an explicit visual rule; fallback alone does not prove a failure.

Source admits current WMO63/precipitation2 with zero layers, paintClouds leaves cloud alpha0, and tieRainToClouds fails open for weak/no column density. Proposed predicate is cloudAlpha0 with visibleDrops>0, then owner decides whether above-camera origin is acceptable.
